source_text.slice: REQ-517 slice 2b (GH #2535): route classification, stored on, Authorize enforcement, DB error path, attachment-link audit, persisted shadow evidence (ACs 16-22). 2a is merged.

task.description: Implement PR 2b of the REQ-517 design (sections 4.0-4.8). No new tests written beyond the minimal edits to existing tests that the change forces; nothing committed or pushed.

result.summary: 2b implemented. MIX_ENV=test mix compile --warnings-as-errors --force: clean. mix format --check-formatted: clean. mix letflow.check_boundaries: 0 violations (1422 edges). mix letflow.check.static: completed, scope_node_paths and role_scope_grants writer scans no violations. Targeted mix test (51 files in 3 runs): all pass except one pre-existing environment failure, PermissionMatrixTest T24, which reads .github CI yaml with CRLF line endings in this working tree and fails on a String.split of the CRLF text, unrelated to this change. A throwaway scratch test (deleted) exercised: stored on read by get_mode, tenant-wide admin passes under on, a user with no grants gets 403 under on, a malformed Grants struct gives a halted 500 with exactly one scope_enforcement_failed line, ShadowEvidence record then flush then counts_between (additive across two flushes, other days zero, a hostile ETS key dropped and never executed). NOT RUN: the full mix test suite (too long for one call), MIX_ENV=dev mix letflow.permission_matrix --check (no permission atom or role_allows? change was made), the down direction of the two new migrations.
deviations: RouteScope.class_of/1: the key table is consulted BEFORE the declared class (design says declared > key table > default), so an admin-plane key can never be weakened at runtime by a declared option; the walk still reports the conflict as :declared_conflicts_with_key_table.

The macro and Enforce/Shadow accept and pass through a fifth class :self_service (AC 17 and 19 name five classes; design 4.1 lists four). No route carries it; REQ-518 assigns it. The pending_sec_ruling marker for /me/modules and /help/resolved (design 4.1 last paragraph) is NOT implemented here (REQ-518 scope, RA-3).
ShadowEvidence retention prune runs once per UTC day for each prefix the process flushed that day (a tenant that left shadow keeps its old rows).
ShadowEvidence.counts_between/3 returns all seven metric keys, 0 when absent.

Existing tests edited because the change forces it: scope_test T-A8 (resolve instead of ancestors), tenant_fixture_test (56 -> 57 tables) with test/support/tenant_fixture.ex oracle, infrastructure_test (24 -> 25 children), scope_enforcement_test T-F7 (on is now a valid stored changeset value; bogus is not), tenant_scope_enforcement_test T-F1 SQL case (ON, not on, violates the widened CHECK).

Test support created beyond the design list is none; the design-listed test/support/route_inventory.ex and scope_enforcement_fixture.ex and the snapshot file were generated here (snapshot: 143 default-sourced routes of 173; audit_routes returned []).
notes_for_test_designer: NOT created: test/fixtures/route_scope/off_shadow_responses.json (T-G1) -- it must be captured from unchanged main behavior; no off/shadow HTTP response was changed by this code.

Unverified assumption now verified once ad hoc: Repo.insert_all with prefix: plus a query-form on_conflict produces INSERT ... AS s0 ... DO UPDATE SET count = s0.count + EXCLUDED.count against the tenant schema.

The 2b target tests that must still be written: route_scope_walk_test, admin_plane_under_on_test, Enforce unit tests, ShadowEvidence tests (async false), link audit tests, migration tests (including down raising while a tenant is on).
Enforce.check/3 with a malformed Grants struct (rows_by_role not a map) gives a halted 500 and one scope_enforcement_failed class=error exception=BadMapError line.
sec_code_gate_followups: F-1: RouteScope.audit_routes/2 now also returns {:self_service_not_allowed, row} for any route of class :self_service and {:unexpected_filter_route, row} for any :filter route outside the committed expectation (empty).
F-3: audit_routes/2 returns {:unknown_permission, key} when required_permission(key) is not in Authorization.permissions(); the real route table audits to [].
F-4: design section 4.1 amended to the as-built rule (key table before declared, five classes, :self_service unused).
